|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]. Other versions: [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2)]] (Original), [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3), [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4), [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 5)]] (PC-E5, the current text). No published image prints this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB2-169-Luke_s_Blaster_Pistol-PC-E2-cardmaker.png]], made 11 November 2026). The forum post has no image.
* '''Original''' ([[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=11 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 11, slip 169. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Luke. During battle, opponent may not move from here. Twice per battle, may target a character (target loses immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]]): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 26 August 2011 (an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook)<ref name="forum-p644156">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 26 August 2011: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p644156 p644156] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “Deploy on Luke. During battle, opponent may not move from here. Twice per battle, may target a character (target loses any immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.” '''What changed:''' “loses immunity” became “loses any immunity”; “Twice per battle” stays.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Competitive Balance Team errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 11 April 2012, legal from 20 April 2012 (“Any previously issued errata to any of these four cards should obviously be ignored”)<ref name="forum-p710277">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 11 April 2012: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=40#p710277 p710277] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “Deploy on Luke. During battle, opponent may not move from here. May target a character (target loses any immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.” '''What changed:''' “Twice per battle, may target” became “May target” (a weapon may fire once per battle), so the pistol no longer fires twice.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1220_169-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy on Luke. During battle, opponent may not move from here. Once per battle, may target a character (target loses immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.” '''What changed:''' “May target” became “Once per battle, may target”, and “loses any immunity” went back to “loses immunity”. The Players Committee's card data of 2010 still had the original text, so the card-list wording first appears here.
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 4)]]): the Players Committee card image, dated 25 February 2013 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual2-Light">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/</code>, every card image dated 25 February 2013: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034559/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “Deploy on Luke. During battle, opponent may not move from here. May target a character (target loses any immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' “Once per battle, may target” became “May target” and “loses immunity” became “loses any immunity”: word for word the PC-E2 text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E5''' ([[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 5)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (cover “official text as of 27 April 2013”; Light Side, p. 54)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=54, page 54. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=54 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Luke. During battle, opponent may not move from here. May target a character (target loses any immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.” '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the PC-E2 and PC-E4 text. The Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata, p. A-14; PDF created by 27 August 2012) lists the same words. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
